name: multicursor
description: Multiple cursors: add one at the next match, skip, select every match, add above or below

commands.name: add_next
commands.description: Add a cursor at the next match of the word or selection

commands.name: add_previous
commands.description: Add a cursor at the previous match

commands.name: skip
commands.description: Move the last cursor to the next match instead

commands.name: all
commands.description: Select every match of the word or selection

commands.name: add_below
commands.description: Add a cursor on the line below

commands.name: add_above
commands.description: Add a cursor on the line above
